nodes.name: summary
nodes.notes: Why Code: runs the shared replay engine (dailySummary) over every user's history; returns no item when nothing happened so nothing is posted.

parameters.content:
## paper-trading-daily
Daily 12:05 UTC: builds the anonymous 24h summary (needs at least 3 traders; otherwise no item and nothing is posted). The first time there is a summary, `create-pm` sends a private message to the Discourse group `paper-trading` as system and `save-topic` stores its topic id in workflow static data. Later runs reply in that same message through `post-summary`. Static data only persists for production runs; to start a new thread clear it or delete `topicId`. Paste dist/n8n-daily.js on top of `summary`.

nodes.name: daily-topic

parameters.jsCode:
const topicId = $getWorkflowStaticData('global').topicId;
return [{ json: { raw: $input.first().json.raw, topicId } }];

nodes.notes: Why Code: reads workflow static data (topicId of the group message), which no native node can access.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ archetype: 'private_message', target_recipients: 'paper-trading', title: 'paper trading: resumen diario', raw: $json.raw }) }}
